title: The Aftermath of the family house on Kessler Street
author: Astrid Oyelaran
blurb: Rafael Underhill, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the house sale closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
